purpose: Record Hamish's read-only authorization for existing sibling lanes while preserving open phase guardrails.

user_authorization_summary.authorization_note: Existing sibling lanes may continue in read-only advisory mode. This does not approve new sibling creation, replacement lanes, old-style subagent spawning, raw transcript publication, external account mutation, or private identifier publication.

allowed: bounded read-only inspections needed for the active phase
route health checks that do not reveal private callable identifiers
phase planning, reflection, and handoff synthesis
not_allowed: new thread or replacement sibling creation
private thread or callable identifier publication
credential, screenshot, or local private dump publication
read_only_lane_contract.repo_publication_boundary: Only curated status receipts, ledgers, validators, and planning artifacts may be committed after validation and exact staging.

current_phase_state.known_open_blocker_summary: App-lane private map remains unavailable through exposed safe surfaces; existing route discovery is insufficient for the open app lanes.
current_phase_state.advance_rule: Do not move into the next phase boundary from v507 v8 until required lane evidence is recovered or Hamish approves an explicit blocker-boundary override.
